name: Hymenaeus
bio: Hymenaeus, along with Alexander, had rejected faith and a good conscience; Paul delivered them over to Satan so that they might learn not to blaspheme (1 Timothy 1:19-20). He is later mentioned again as one who had strayed from the truth, teaching that the resurrection had already occurred (2 Timothy 2:17-18). He is paired with Philetus as one spreading teaching that the resurrection had already occurred, undermining some believers' faith (2 Timothy 2:17-18).
